intro: Chef Grual is the resident cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. In a secluded town choked by mist and monsters, Grual does his best to keep the Night Watch and weary travelers fed, even if his choice of ingredients raises eyebrows.

p: Running an eatery in Darkshire is a grim task. With supply lines from Westfall and Stormwind constantly harassed by highwaymen, wolves, and undead, fresh provisions are virtually nonexistent. Grual makes do with whatever the wilderness provides. From wolf flank to whatever scavenged meats local adventurers drag through the door, Grual cooks with pragmatism born of necessity.

Grual is infamous for his specialty dishes, most notably his famous 'Dusky Crab Cakes' and seasoned wolf kabobs. Given that coastal crabs are nowhere near the gloomy inland woods of Duskwood, his crab cakes rely on a rather revolting substitute: the gooey legs of local Venom Web Spiders. Whether patrons realize they are eating arachnid meat or simply prefer not to ask, Grual keeps the kitchen running without apologies.
